summary: The generated scraper emitted story_points and comment_count instead of the contracted keys, and every value came back 0, so all four fields read dead. The re-weave restored title and points and comments and author and Integrity returned to 100%.
heal_prompt: Extract from each row on the Hacker News front page. Rows are tr.athing.submission plus the following tr with td.subtext. Output exactly these keys: title = text of span.titleline > a; points = integer parsed from span.score; comments = integer from the last td.subtext link ending in "comments", 0 if it says "discuss"; author = text of a.hnuser. Return 30 rows. Do not output story_points, comment_count or product_page_url.
